CSS break-before — interactive matrix

Resize the window, then use Left/Right or Page Up/Page Down. A reader page contains every visible column.

AUTO

break-before: auto

This card follows normal flow and consumes no forced boundary.

AVOID PAIR — FIRST

This orange card is the previous sibling of the next card.

AVOID PAIR — SECOND

break-before: avoid

If the boundary would fall between these two orange cards, both move together when they fit.

NEXT COLUMN

break-before: column

This card must start at the top of the next column while remaining on the same reader page.

NEXT READER PAGE

break-before: page

This card skips every column remaining on the previous reader page and starts in column one.

LEGACY NEXT PAGE

page-break-before: always

The legacy EPUB spelling has the same reader-page behavior as break-before: page.

LEFT FALLBACK

break-before: left

Facing-page parity is not modeled, so this safely degrades to an ordinary next-page break.

RIGHT FALLBACK

break-before: right

Facing-page parity is not modeled, so this also degrades to an ordinary next-page break.
